# Third-party development sources

`sources/better-sqlite3-v12.12.0.tar.gz` is a deterministic `git archive` of public MIT-licensed better-sqlite3 commit `38f111acfacced350ac17e62944ba9a4dbd176e5` (tag `v12.12.0`). Its SHA-256 is `116a8f653c1d9a9bf35bd4e89e07f4dc4385ad6c54e50554a778924edd49d785`.

The tag is not signed. The exact commit, archive hash, upstream license, wrapper-file comparison, and embedded SQLite 3.53.3 match are therefore recorded explicitly. This source is used only to build a target-native addon; the proprietary imported Windows binary is not redistributed.

Other Homebrew libraries remain development inputs until source archives, hashes, build flags, licenses, and packaging decisions are frozen in `DEPENDENCIES.lock.json`.
